runtime.skill_tree_digest: stable-v2: sha256 over every sorted relative POSIX runtime path, one NUL byte, file bytes, one NUL byte; exclude only generated __pycache__, .pyc, and .pyo files
runtime.harness: record the concrete harness in the result
runtime.model: record the concrete model identifier when exposed; otherwise record the family and an explicit limitation

producer_context: runtime references required by that entrypoint

promotion_review.baseline: the pinned original Caveman core plus its six companion skill entrypoints, without Super Caveman or i-have-adhd response rules
promotion_review.candidate: the frozen Super Caveman runtime used by the passing behavior result
promotion_review.judge_records: Git-external; aggregate identities, orders, votes, digests, and limitations belong in the passing result

exact_diff_human_approval.review_scope: all staged task paths except the aggregate result and aggregate approval record
exact_diff_human_approval.digest_algorithm: sha256 over sorted canonical path/blob tuples after excluding the aggregate result and aggregate approval record; each tuple binds the relative path, base blob object ID or deletion marker, and target blob object ID or deletion marker with NUL delimiters; path_set_sha256 separately binds the sorted NUL-delimited path set; raw Git metadata makes the digest independent of display diff configuration, attributes, custom diff drivers, text conversion, and rename detection; the benchmark recomputes the staged index tuple set before commit and the equivalent base_commit..approval-anchor tuple set on committed replay
exact_diff_human_approval.record_storage: Git aggregate receipt; raw approval Git-external
exact_diff_human_approval.raw_record_validation: required for every promotion ingest and replay; SUPER_CAVEMAN_APPROVAL_RECORD and SUPER_CAVEMAN_REVIEW_RECORD must both name absolute Git-external regular files; verify the approval record's actual SHA-256, schema, decision, approver, timestamp, base commit, path-set digest, and tuple digest; verify the reviewer record's actual SHA-256, schema, identity, candidate raw-output SHA-256, and case-set SHA-256 against the aggregate result
exact_diff_human_approval.approved_replay_validation: every replay revalidates both Git-external raw records before deterministic verification; current staged or committed exact-diff validation remains required; staged replay also requires the aggregate result and aggregate approval record to have byte-identical index and working-tree copies; committed replay anchors to the earliest base-descendant and HEAD-ancestor commit whose aggregate result and approval record bytes exactly match the current receipts, permits later unrelated commits, and rejects later commits or working-tree changes that touch any approved subject path

claim_gate.single_run_claim: one bounded attempt in the recorded harness/model only
claim_gate.cross_harness_claim: not permitted without an equivalent recorded run for each harness/model
